South Korea Warns Ukraine Over North Korean POW Disclosure

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung warned on Friday that unspecified "additional actions" would be taken against Ukraine unless Kyiv acknowledges a "confidentiality agreement" regarding the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers and issues an apology. The dispute arose from Ukraine's disclosure of the transfer, which Seoul states violated an agreement to keep the matter confidential. An analyst suggested the dispute raises serious questions over trust between the two nations.
